title: Build the Estudo home screen
description:
## What changes for the user
Today there is no study home: curricula and subjects are only reachable one by one. After this lands, Estudo shows your streak and weekly numbers, the curricula in a carousel, and every subject as covers or as a table, with one click to add a curriculum, a question or a link.

## Outcome
The Estudo home at `/estudo`, replacing its placeholder, with topbar, title, streak band, curricula carousel and the Assuntos section with its Capas / Tabela views.

## Context
Norte is a learning and life-projects app with a Portuguese UI: a reading library, goal-first curricula, spaced-review flashcards, notes, and areas, projects, decisions and tasks. This repo ports a design-tool prototype to Vue 3 + Vite + TypeScript + Vue Router. It is frontend only: every screen runs on mock data, and there is no backend yet.

Where the design lives:
- `design/prototypes/` holds the prototype, one export per screen. It is git-ignored, so it exists only in the main checkout. Open `design/prototypes/Norte - <Screen> (standalone).html` in a browser to see the screen. Read `design/prototypes/<Screen>/template.html` for markup, inline styles and behaviour. The behaviour is a `class Component extends DCLogic` block with React-style `state`/`setState`. The template uses a design-tool runtime whose `sc-if`, `sc-for` and `{{ }}` bindings map almost one to one onto `v-if`, `v-for` and `{{ }}`. Prototype links point at `Norte - X.dc.html?param=`; translate them into the routes below.
- `design/system/` holds the committed design system. It has tokens in `tokens.css`/`tokens.json` (colour, type, a 4px spacing scale, radius, shadow), one `components/<Name>/README.md` per component, props in `components/index.d.ts`, and screenshots in `screenshots/`. Fonts are in `fonts/`: Schibsted Grotesk for display, Geist for sans and Commit Mono for mono.
- There are two themes, Claro and Escuro, switched by `data-theme` on the root element and stored in `localStorage` under `norte-theme`. The visual rule is quiet: one cobalt accent, no cards, no gradients, no warm colours.

Route table (shared by every screen):
- `/` is Início (Command Home).
- `/biblioteca` is the library, with query `v` = `inbox|depois|arquivo|tudo` and `tipo`.
- `/notas` is notes, with query `tab` = `highlights|anotacoes|perguntas`.
- `/revisao` is the flashcard review.
- `/estudo` is the Estudo home (Currículos and Assuntos).
- `/curriculos/:slug` is one curriculum.
- `/material/:kind/:id` is one reading item, where kind is `post|livro|paper`.
- `/projetos` is the project list.
- `/areas/:id` is one area.
- `/projetos/:id` is one project.
- `/decisoes/:id` is one decision.
- `/tarefas/:id` is one task.

The repo is public. Never copy the prototype's mock content (health, money, career, named people) into code; use the neutral invented data in `web/src/mock/`. UI strings stay Portuguese.

The repo is a monorepo: the Vue app lives in `web/` and a Go backend will live in `server/` and later serve the built app from one binary. All frontend paths below are under `web/`; `design/` stays at the repo root. The gate is `npm run build && npm test`, run in `web/`.

Reference: `design/prototypes/Home_A/template.html` and `design/prototypes/Norte - Home A (standalone).html`. Mounted at `/estudo`.

Regions in order:
- A topbar with a search input (placeholder "Buscar cursos, notas, perguntas…") that opens the command palette when one exists, a secondary "Adicionar" button with a dropdown, and a primary link to Revisão.
- PageTitle with the current date as title ("Sexta, 2 de outubro" style, from `Intl.DateTimeFormat('pt-BR')`) and a weekly-focus objective.
- A streak band: StreakGrid of 182 days plus four Stat: "Streak atual" (with record), "Estudadas esta semana" (hours), "Para revisar hoje" (cards), and "Concluídos em <month>" (items).
- "Currículos": a Carousel of curriculum covers, 248px cards, 4 visible, stepping by 2. The prototype builds this by hand; use the design-system Carousel and CoverCard instead.
- "Assuntos": a SegmentedControl "Capas / Tabela", default Capas. Capas is a 3-column cover grid. Tabela has columns Assunto, Currículos, Cursos, Artigos, Vídeos, Notas, Perguntas, Atividade.

The Adicionar menu has three items: new curriculum, new question, and save a link. The prototype's sidebar and Shell overlay are the app shell's job, not this view's.

Mock data: this view needs subjects ("assuntos": 6, each with counts per kind and a last-activity label) and study stats (daily activity for 182 days, current and record streak, hours this week, items completed this month). Add those types and data to `web/src/mock/` with invented, neutral content, as the mock-data bead did for the other entities. The prototype also links a "Home B" grid of curricula that was never exported; ignore that link.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] The title shows today's date in pt-BR; the four Stat values and the StreakGrid are computed from `web/src/mock/`.
- [ ] The carousel shows 4 curricula, steps by 2, and disables prev/next at the ends; each card routes to `/curriculos/:slug`.
- [ ] The Capas / Tabela control switches views; both list the same 6 subjects, and each subject routes to `/biblioteca?v=tudo`.
- [ ] Adicionar items route to `/curriculos/nova`, `/notas?tab=perguntas` and `/?save=1`; the Revisão button routes to `/revisao`.
- [ ] Side by side with the prototype at 1440px in both themes, layout, spacing and typography match by eye.
- [ ] Done when: every state and link above works on `/estudo`, and the gate is green.

## Tests
- Component (Vitest + @vue/test-utils, mounted with the real router and mock data): the view renders its title and main regions; each interactive state listed in the acceptance criteria flips as described; each outbound link resolves to the route named in the criteria.
- Unit: the stat helpers (streak, weekly hours, monthly completed) over a fixed activity fixture.

## Blast radius
**Edits:** `web/src/views/StudyHomeView.vue`, `web/src/views/StudyHomeView/`, `web/src/router/index.ts`, `web/src/mock/`

One view plus its route, and additive types and data in `web/src/mock/` for subjects and study stats.

Open `design/prototypes/Norte - <Screen> (standalone).html` in a browser to see the screen. Read `design/prototypes/<Screen>/template.html` for markup, inline styles and behaviour. The behaviour is a `class Component extends DCLogic` block with React-style `state`/`setState`. The template uses a design-tool runtime whose `sc-if`, `sc-for` and `{{ }}` bindings map almost one to one onto `v-if`, `v-for` and `{{ }}`. Prototype links point at `Norte - X.dc.html?param=`; translate them into the routes below.
- `design/system/` holds the committed design system. It has tokens in `tokens.css`/`tokens.json` (colour, type, a 4px spacing scale, radius, shadow), one `components/<Name>/README.md` per component, props in `components/index.d.ts`, and screenshots in `screenshots/`. Fonts are in `fonts/`: Schibsted Grotesk for display, Geist for sans and Commit Mono for mono.
- There are two themes, Claro and Escuro, switched by `data-theme` on the root element and stored in `localStorage` under `norte-theme`. The visual rule is quiet: one cobalt accent, no cards, no gradients, no warm colours.

Route table (shared by every screen):
- `/` is Início (Command Home).
- `/biblioteca` is the library, with query `v` = `inbox|depois|arquivo|tudo` and `tipo`.
- `/notas` is notes, with query `tab` = `highlights|anotacoes|perguntas`.
- `/revisao` is the flashcard review.
- `/estudo` is the Estudo home (Currículos and Assuntos).
- `/curriculos/:slug` is one curriculum.
- `/material/:kind/:id` is one reading item, where kind is `post|livro|paper`.
- `/projetos` is the project list.
- `/areas/:id` is one area.
- `/projetos/:id` is one project.
- `/decisoes/:id` is one decision.
- `/tarefas/:id` is one task.

The repo is public. Never copy the prototype's mock content into code; use the neutral invented data in `web/src/mock/`. UI strings stay Portuguese.

The repo is a monorepo: the Vue app lives in `web/` and a Go backend will live in `server/` and later serve the built app from one binary. All frontend paths below are under `web/`; `design/` stays at the repo root. The gate is `npm run build && npm test`, run in `web/`.

Reference: `design/prototypes/Curriculo/template.html` and its standalone HTML. Mounted at `/curriculos/:slug`.

Pick the curriculum by `:slug` from the mock data. Regions: PageTitle with the objective; a module ruler; a ModuleItem accordion of MaterialRows, each with status done / current / next / skipped and O/P for required/optional; an "Instrumento" table; exercises; evaluation. Edit mode and "Novo currículo" live in the same screen; for now they edit the mock store in memory. The slug `nova` opens "Novo currículo" as an empty edit form; any other unknown slug shows a not-found state.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Every mock slug renders its own title and modules; `/curriculos/nova` opens an empty edit form that saves a new curriculum; any other unknown slug shows a not-found message.
- [ ] Modules expand and collapse; a MaterialRow routes to `/material/:kind/:id`.
- [ ] Edit mode toggles inputs for title, objective and module titles, and saving updates the page.
- [ ] Side by side with the prototype at 1440px in both themes, layout, spacing and typography match by eye.
- [ ] Done when: every state and link above works on `/curriculos/:slug`, and the gate is green.

## Tests
- Component (Vitest + @vue/test-utils, mounted with the real router and mock data): the view renders its title and main regions; each interactive state listed in the acceptance criteria flips as described; each outbound link resolves to the route named in the criteria.
